title: Sunday · Landscapes, Again · mudflats, low tide
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The October 2008 mudflats Sunday rerun in May 2015. The tide in the reprint is October's. The reader can tell by the light, if they've been paying attention, which is the point of a rerun.
